title: Success Rates of Government Career Assistance Schemes
what_it_is: Success Rates of Government Career Assistance Schemes

sections.label: PMET jobs and conversion programmes
sections.summary: 6,400 PMETs found jobs through WSG and e2i in the first three quarters, and PCPs are increasing from 22 to more than 50.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: In the first three quarters of this year, 6,400 PMETs found jobs through the assistance of Workforce Singapore (WSG) and the Employment and Employability Institute (e2i).

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: To help more PMETs to take up available jobs in a different profession, we are increasing the number of Professional Conversion Programmes (PCPs) from 22 covering 12 sectors at the beginning of this year to more than 50 covering almost all sectors by the end of the year.

sections.label: Wage support and SME placements
sections.summary: Over 200 of 1,500 eligible PMETs received wage support under CSP since October 2015, and about 900 PMETs secured SME jobs under P-Max this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: Out of 1,500 eligible PMETs who have registered with WSG and e2i, more than 200 have received such wage support through their new employers since the inception of CSP in October 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: We have also helped about 900 PMETs to secure jobs in small and medium enterprises (SMEs) under P-Max so far this year.

sections.label: PCP, P-Max and CSP targets
sections.summary: PCP is sector by sector, P-Max targets the SME sector, and CSP targets those with an expectation gap.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: PCP is sector by sector; P-Max is targeted at the SME sector; and CSP is targeted more at those with this expectation gap.

sections.label: Employment periods and tracked outcomes
sections.summary: CSP requires a minimum one-year employment period, PCP is tracked after, and the key tracked number is unemployment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: For example, in the case of CSP, the employment period must be a minimum of one year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: In the case Page: 10 of PCP, we do track after that.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: But at the end of the day, the key number that we track is the unemployment number.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: Some of them, after their professional conversion, they go and work for a company.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: But even if they have left the company, as long as they continue to be in employment, to us, the outcome is still a positive one.
